$comment: SHULL Studio design tokens. THE ONLY PLACE A HEX VALUE IS WRITTEN. CSS, the slide template's tokens.js, and the documentation are generated from this file; scripts/validate_tokens.py fails the build on a raw hex found anywhere else. Every 'measured' block is computed by scripts/measure_tokens.py - never hand-edit one. Run that script after changing any hex.

printBody.note: No text below this on a student page except the running footer.

printFooter.note: Bounds the footer exception. See CONFLICT-19.

slideScale.$comment: Slide System v2 scale. Supersedes the older slide-standard.md scale - see CONFLICT-07.

slideGeometry.$comment: Slide System v2 geometry, taken from the build that produced the approved prototype deck. Supersedes the slide-standard.md coordinates, which were paired here with the v2 type scale by mistake - see SHULL-CHG-0013 finding 3. All measurements in inches from the top-left.

footerChip.note: slide-standard.md specified a rounded chip at y 6.9, deliberately the same chip family as the printed practice-set banner. Slide System v2 replaced it with plain footer text and left no record of why. v2 is what shipped and what was approved, so v2 is built. Whether the slide-to-print chip link should be restored is an open question for the user - SHULL-CHG-0013 finding 3.

rules.note: Every colour used as type must clear contrastTargetText against its ground. Any two colours carrying a categorical distinction must differ by at least grayscaleSeparationMin, or differ additionally by border and label.
